value.rationale: The exact Gaussian width and explicit deterministic displacement address a material practical gap in quorum-time uncertainty quantification: using the first-order mean crossing as a Gaussian center is correct below s=1/2, produces a nonzero location shift at s=1/2, and generically fails above it. This is a natural, all-exponent structural phase transition rather than a selected numerical example or generic CLT without a meaningful bias calculation.
